info.name: Service On Click - admin / approver / super admin API
info.description: The management endpoints added with the admin side. See docs/admin-api.md. Set {{baseUrl}} and paste a personal access token into {{token}} (the browser sends it in the ServOnClickAccessToken cookie; here it travels as a Bearer token).

item.name: List (filters: q, statuses, types, stage, mine, overdue, sync, sort...)
Attachment - bytes of a file or image (kind: file | image)

request.description: Who: any manager who may see the booking. Take kind and id from `attachments[]` of the detail; 404 until the bytes have arrived
Who: the role whose turn it is
Who: the role whose turn it is
Who: any manager. Bookings are opened in the mobile app only

item.name: Bookings report - list (every filter optional, they combine)

request.description: Who: admin (own unit, the booking types they administer), super admin (every booking). Newest first. Days are counted in EXPORT_REPORT_TIMEZONE and both ends are included.

item.name: Bookings report - export to Excel (copy kept in the bucket folder export-report)

request.description: Who: admin, super admin. Same filters as the list (page and per_page are ignored); all the matching bookings. Answers with the file bookings_<date>_<time>.xlsx - use Send and Download in Postman.
Who: whoever manages the type in the unit
Who: whoever manages the type in the unit
Who: super admin. Returns 201 and the field; it is queued for the mobile app

item.name: Form field - change (send the version and only what changes)

request.description: Who: super admin. 409 on a stale version; a field of the mobile app is never retyped

item.name: Form field - new order (ids of ALL the stand-alone fields)

request.description: Who: super admin. 409 when the list is not the form as it is now

item.name: Form field - remove (archived when bookings hold values)

request.description: Who: super admin. Returns { mode: delete | archive, used_by }; a field of the mobile app is refused (422)
